name: energy-ball
description: Rasengan-style energy orb on the speaker's hand: swirling core, spiral bands, wind rings and sparks spiralling out; enters with a flash and shockwave, implodes at the end.

params.x: optional px position when there is no hand track (else gesture place, else centre)
params.y: optional px position when there is no hand track

name: stat-card
description: One big number that counts up on a white card with a highlighter sweep, a label and an optional note; optional darkened screenshot behind.

params.value: the number (counts up from 0; decimals kept)
params.prefix: optional text before the number, e.g. "$"
params.suffix: optional text after the number, e.g. "%" or " mln"
params.label: what the number means (short sentence)
params.media: optional screenshot shown darkened behind the card

name: flow
description: Step-by-step diagram: 2-6 numbered boxes pop in one by one and arrows draw between them (clean cards or hand-drawn Rough.js).

name: ui-mock
description: Mock app window whose text types in character by character: an AI chat, a terminal session or a social post.

params.lines: [{"who": "user"|"ai"|"cmd", "text": "..."}, ...] (terminal: user/cmd typed after $, ai printed as output)
params.title: optional window / account name

name: iso-machine
description: Isometric 3D machine (product-diagram style): 2-5 parts drop in and assemble on a conveyor, gears turn, a press stamps, tokens index through station by station, numbered labels point at the parts, optional output counter.

params.parts: 2-5 items {"label", "shape": "box"|"cylinder"|"funnel"|"screen"|"gear", "color"?} in process order (box = housing, cylinder = piston press, funnel = hopper, screen = monitor + scanner, gear = gearbox)
params.token: optional "cube" or "sphere": items travelling through the parts on the conveyor
params.counter: optional {"to": number, "label": "..."}: an output crate whose number counts up as tokens land in it
params.title: optional heading above the machine
params.accent: optional accent colour for tokens / crate / screen (default theme --accent)

name: showcase-3d
description: Hero 3D object beside the speaker: flies in on a curve from off-screen, turns slowly and flies out. Glossy clearcoat material under studio light (key, two coloured rims, reflections), rim glow, halo and floating dust. Shapes: torus knot, faceted gem, 3D text or your own GLB model.

params.text: the word for shape "text" (extruded; Polish letters use Droid Sans Bold)
params.model: GLB file for shape "glb": put the graphic-level "media": "broll/<file>.glb" (build copies it), or a file name inside the effect folder (P.assets); falls back to the torus knot if it cannot load
params.color: base colour (default "#7c3aed"); rim lights use its complement
params.size: object size as a fraction of the shorter frame side (default 0.4)
params.x: optional px x of the centre (default: gesture place, else the right third)
params.y: optional px y of the centre (default: gesture place, else 45% down)

name: burst
description: One-shot impact (0.6-1.0 s): white flash, double shockwave ring, streak sparks with drag and gravity, falling embers.

params.size: reach multiplier (default 1 = 20% of the shorter frame side)
params.x: optional px x (default: gesture place, else centre)
params.y: optional px y (default: gesture place, else centre)
